nodes.title: Deep Learning-based RF Fingerprint Authentication with Chaotic Antenna Arrays
nodes.dataset: Simulation data of 300 CAAs, each with 4 antenna elements, under varying channel conditions and Doppler shifts.
nodes.methodology: Utilizes deep learning (CNNs) with chaotic antenna arrays (CAAs) for authentication. CAAs introduce randomness in antenna geometry and feed lines to generate unique RF fingerprints.
nodes.contribution: Introduces PUWS with CAAs for hardware-based authentication, demonstrating deep learning's effectiveness in enhancing RF fingerprinting for secure IoT systems.

nodes.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Feature Extraction Techniques Using I/Q Imbalance in RFFI
nodes.dataset: LTE mobile devices, USRP platforms, simulated signals with 5 analog transmitters (400 signals, 50% train/test split).
nodes.methodology: Comprehensive review of I/Q imbalance-based RFFI techniques, discussion of other hardware impairments (power amplifier nonlinearity, oscillator imperfections), and analysis of ML/DL approaches for device identification.
nodes.contribution: Comprehensive survey of I/Q imbalance-based RFFI techniques, analysis of hardware impairments, and evaluation of ML/DL-driven solutions for device identification.

nodes.title: Communication Signal Recognition 1 Open-Set RF Fingerprinting via Improved Prototype Learning
nodes.dataset: WIDEFT, an open-source RF dataset collected from 138 real-world devices across 79 models, with 18 Apple Inc. 2.4 GHz WiFi devices used for evaluation (10 known classes, 8 unknown classes).
nodes.methodology: The paper introduces Improved Prototype Learning (IPL) with two key enhancements: consistency-based regularization (enforces feature consistency via data augmentation) and online label smoothing (reduces class overlap in feature space). These methods are integrated into a prototype learning framework for open-set recognition.
nodes.contribution: The paper introduces consistency-based regularization and online label smoothing to enhance prototype learning, enabling effective open-set recognition for RF fingerprinting in real-world scenarios.

nodes.title: An Identity Authentication Method of a MIoT Device Based on Radio Frequency (RF) Fingerprint Technology
nodes.methodology: Combines support vector data description (SVDD) and neighborhood component analysis (NCA) for RF fingerprint-based device authentication.
nodes.contribution: Establishes an RF fingerprint authentication model for MIoT devices to distinguish authentic and rogue devices effectively.

nodes.title: Attention is Needed for RF Fingerprinting
nodes.dataset: Actual collected RF fingerprinting datasets (specific name not provided)
nodes.methodology: Proposes a Dual Attention Convolution (DAConv) module combining channel attention and spatial attention branches to refine RF fingerprints. Integrates with existing CNN architectures for improved feature learning.
nodes.contribution: Introduced DAConv module for attention-based RF fingerprinting. Demonstrated effectiveness in enhancing robustness and discriminability of fingerprints.
